bodyHtml:
Aquasky has proved our products are of great quality by complying with the WaterMark certification. The WaterMark Standard is the highest standard for water equipment for Australia and New Zealand.

The WaterMark Certification Scheme is a mandatory certification scheme for plumbing and drainage products to ensure they are suitable for purpose and appropriately authorized for use in plumbing and drainage installations.

Aquasky is a successful in-service for Australian and New Zealand customers.
